mapper.sql: SELECT an.*, b.name AS batch_name, u.display_name AS creator_name FROM announcement an LEFT JOIN selection_batch b ON b.id = an.batch_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = an.created_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO announcement (batch_id, title, type, content, status, publish_start, publish_end, created_by) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{title}, #{type}, #{content}, #{status}, #{publishStart}, #{publishEnd}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: WHERE an.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND (an.publish_start IS NULL OR an.publish_start <= NOW()) AND (an.publish_end IS NULL OR an.publish_end >= NOW()) ORDER BY an.publish_start DESC, an.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
WHERE an.batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY an.id DESC
